mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of months following YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates weaker economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 50.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances following a 0.5pp UNRATE spike.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals overexuberance in the housing market and impending demand slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of months following a 10% YoY rise in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline simultaneously over a 3-month period, it signals an overheating labor market that will lead to wage inflation and Fed tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a high-inflation, low-rate environment that will lead to a hawkish Fed pivot and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 5% quarter-over-quarter, it signals a sharp demand slowdown that will lead to negative earnings revisions and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 60% of instances following a 5% QoQ decline in RSAFS.
